correctness.rationale: At radius one, 20 connected graph vertices and 30 edges (girth six) give rank 11 in H1. Independent BFS gives distance shells 30,60,60,30,10 for distances 1..5. Exact simplex enumeration at r=2 gives f=(20,90,120,30), 260 faces, 120 matched codimension-one pairs, 20 critical cells (one vertex and nineteen dimension two), all 660 Hasse covers acyclic. At r=3, f=(20,150,540,1000,960,450,80), 3200 faces, 1599 pairs, one critical vertex and one dimension-three cell; complete 13980-cover directed topological sort. Thus Forman theory yields wedges of 19 S2 and S3 respectively, not just Betti ranks. At r=4 ten antipodal nonedges yield the boundary of a ten-dimensional cross-polytope (S9), and r>=5 is a simplex. Different nonzero degrees at successive scales make all cross-stage positive reduced maps zero, giving the claimed integral barcodes. Reconstructed from graph and inspected verifier; complete matching, not finite sampling of an infinite claim.
